source_caption:
A Keanu-led adaptation of “KILL CURRENT: A Jon Hendricks Thriller” is in the works with @TheArena.

Jon Hendricks is a burned-out CIA officer in Oliver Lowe’s latest thriller novel, who is pulled back into action to avenge the protégé he trained and lost. The story dives into the issues shaping today’s headlines, from technological and informational warfare to the changing nature of global conflict.

A new global action franchise begins here. #JonHendricks
